overview_description.description:
CliniDo is a MedTech company that helps patients make and schedule appointments with doctors, archiving their medical records on the app. 
Our main profession is tackling the real pain facing the patients in finding and booking appropriate healthcare providers, in addition to the problem of managing and archiving their medical records, also we're helping the healthcare providers in digitizing their practice and use our innovative solution in improving their service level.

product.name: Online Doctor Booking Platform
product.description: A digital platform that allows patients to search for and book appointments with healthcare providers across various specialties and locations.

product.name: Online Medical Consultations (Teleconsultations)
product.description: A service that facilitates remote medical consultations between patients and doctors via voice or video calls through the platform or app.

product.name: Home Visit Booking Service
product.description: A service that enables patients to schedule in-home visits by healthcare providers through the CliniDo platform or app.
